content_md:
## What Is MockupHive?

MockupHive is a mockup template marketplace launched in June 2026 offering 2000+ high-resolution PSD templates across 9 categories plus an AI text-to-mockup generator. It provides drag-and-drop online editing PSD smart object downloads and native plugins for Figma and Adobe Express.

## Key Features for Print Shops and POD Sellers

### 2000+ Templates in 9 Categories
Device (689) Apparel (258) Branding (280) Packaging (121) Print (170) Stationery (206) Social Media (134) Vehicle (9) Magazine (5)

### AI Text-to-Mockup Generator
Prompt-based generation with auto surface detection perspective wrapping lighting/shadow. Under 15 seconds generation time.

### Figma Plugin and Adobe Express Add-on
Native community plugin and add-on for seamless workflow integration.

### Commercial License
Standard license on Pro Extended on Unlimited/Lifetime. Usable for commercial POD listings.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Downloads/Day | AI Credits |
|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| Free | $0 | 1 | 10 (one-time) |
| Pro Monthly | $9/mo | 30 | 100/mo |
| Pro Annual | $24-29/yr | 30 | 100/yr |
| Unlimited Monthly | $15/mo | Unlimited | 300/mo |
| Unlimited Annual | $39-49/yr | Unlimited | 300/yr |
| Lifetime | $199-299 one-time | Unlimited | 500 (one-time) |

## Value for Print Shops / POD Sellers

1. Upload your product design to MockupHive
2. Browse 258 apparel templates for T-shirts hoodies jerseys
3. Apply your design via online editor (no Photoshop needed)
4. Use AI generator for unique perspectives in under 15 seconds
5. Export high-resolution PNG or PSD with smart objects
6. List directly on Shopify Etsy or Amazon

Estimated time savings: Traditional mockup creation 2-3 hours per product. With MockupHive: 5-15 minutes.

## Verdict

Use it if: You need affordable fast mockup generation and don't mind a newer platform. The Lifetime plan is excellent value.

Skip it if: You require established third-party validation need POD-specific templates or want to earn affiliate commissions promoting it.
